content: The Forge (ConfettiFX/The-Forge): Apache License 2.0 for open platforms (commercial license required for console targets). Backends: DirectX 12 (Windows, now prioritized over Vulkan on Windows -- Vulkan was removed from the Windows runtime in a recent release), Vulkan 1.1 (Android/Linux/Steam Deck/Switch/Quest2), Metal (macOS/iOS), plus DXR/VK_KHR_ray_query ray tracing. No CPU/software rendering fallback of any kind. Actively maintained -- release 1.63 shipped March 2025, ~40 graphics-programmer team.
